svg.title: Microsoft Copilot — Microsoft Copilot
svg.desc: The sourced Microsoft Copilot brand mark, preserving its original vector silhouette and using the supplied primary brand colour. No extra outline is added. Official Microsoft Copilot application icon. Original colors and vector gradients are preserved. The source page labels this asset Microsoft Copilot; it is distinct from GitHub Copilot.
